title: sc-data-flow-map manifest
description: Where a repository's data-flow register lives, what surface its canvas may be published to, and the jurisdictions and processors the map is judged against. The surface is required: the canvas names processors, hostnames and where personal data sits, and publishing it without a declared surface is an undeclared outward send.

register.description: Path the machine-readable register is written to. Defaults to .claude/data-flow/register.yaml. Regenerated deterministically: a second consecutive run is a zero diff.

surface.description: The sc-nda-check surface the canvas is cleared for. Required: an undeclared surface is treated as public, the most restrictive, and the canvas is withheld until the check passes.

canvas.description: Local path the canvas HTML is written to before any publish. The local file is always written; publishing is gated.

jurisdictions.description: Regimes the map is read against (e.g. uk-gdpr, eu-gdpr, hipaa, pci-dss). Drives which sink rules are blockers.

processors.description: Known third-party processors and their transfer mechanism. A sink resolving to a processor absent here is an unknown destination, which is a finding.

classification_extensions.description: Additional classes beyond the shipped taxonomy. Extensions add classes; they never redefine or relax a shipped one.

scope.description: An excluded path is unmapped, not clean, so exclusions belong here where they are reviewable.
